title: UWell Caliburn G4 Mini Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The UWell Caliburn G4 Mini Pod Vape Device features a sleek, compact design and a powerful 1100mAh battery for all-day use. Powered by UWell Pro-FOCS 4.0 technology, the UWell Caliburn G4 Mini Pod Vape Device represents a major leap forward in flavor preservation and intensity. This advance system ensures your e-juice tastes exactly as intended, deliver a remarkable 35% increase in flavor satisfaction compared to previous models. With adjustable airflow and wide cartridge compatibility, it’s a standout choice for vapers seeking performance and portability.
